w10_T4_000484: The cafe made 82 pints of soup and then doubled the batch. The cook added 9 pints of stock. Soup is served in cups, at 2 cups to a pint. The cafe served 110 cups, then brought 16 cups back from a cancelled table and ladled out 63 more cups from the reserve pot. How many cups of soup are there?
w10_T4_000491: In the morning the mechanic had 131 bolts and used 37 on a truck. In the afternoon she used 61 on a tractor, then fitted 6 washers to every remaining bolt. In the evening 140 of those washers were used up. How many washers are left?
w10_T4_000492: A rope maker spun 152 yards of rope and then 71 yards more, and made 5 spools of that length. The workshop has 4 windows. She measured the rope in feet, at 3 feet to a yard, and every foot has 3 strands. Twisting each strand takes 6 seconds on the twisting log. How many seconds does the twisting log show?
w10_T4_000499: In the morning the farm had 145 hens, and 47 more arrived, which the farmer counted twice. In the afternoon each hen laid 3 eggs, and the hens did the same for 7 days. In the evening of the last day every egg sold for 5 cents. How many cents did the eggs sell for?
w10_T4_000507: Amir had 60 nickels. He spent 14 of them and gave 20 to Sara, who now has more nickels than Amir. He counted the rest in cents, at 5 cents to a nickel. He then spent 10 cents on a sweet. How many cents does Amir have?
w10_T4_000517: The library had 141 old books, and 115 were discarded. The library opened in 1952. Each remaining book was rebound into 3 slim volumes and placed on the archive shelf. Then 4 volumes, 30 volumes, and 58 volumes were added to the archive shelf. How many volumes are on the archive shelf?
w10_T4_000519: Yara had 101 planks and cut each into 2 boards, then each board into 8 slats. Her workshop is 30 years old. She used 1161 slats for a fence, and each remaining slat was cut into 7 pegs. Every peg gets 2 coats of varnish, and each coat uses 9 millilitres. Her brother Zane used less varnish than Yara. How many millilitres of varnish did Yara use?
w10_T4_000526: Eli had 29 balloons at the party, which lasted 3 hours. Then 6 popped. He gave 16 balloons to Mia, who then had more balloons than Eli. Another 2 floated away, and Mia handed 6 back. How many balloons does Eli have?
w10_T4_000532: The ferry left the island with 29 passengers. The crossing takes 25 minutes. At the first stop 6 people got on and 13 got off. At the second stop 21 got on, and at the harbour 42 got off. How many passengers are still on the ferry?
w10_T4_000534: Rohan had 79 stamps, and his uncle gave him another 79. He traded every stamp for 4 cards and every card for 4 tokens. The tokens, a dozen of which fit in a tube, are 3 centimetres across. He spent 2390 tokens on a model kit. His cousin Isha has fewer tokens than Rohan. How many tokens does Rohan have?
w10_T4_000537: In the morning the shop had 56 umbrellas and sold 52. In the afternoon 1 umbrella broke and a delivery of 7 arrived. In the evening the umbrellas were shared equally between 2 branches. How many umbrellas go to the west branch?
w10_T4_000542: Contractor Ana measured 126 square yards of floor and then 71 more, and converted it to square feet, since a square yard is 9 square feet. Each square foot needs 8 tiles. The tiles were split equally among 6 rooms, and every tile costs 7 dollars. Contractor Ben's quote for the same job was lower than Ana's. How many dollars do the tiles for the first room cost?
w10_T4_000543: In the morning the diner had 177 pints of chowder and sold 78 pints. In the afternoon 7 pints were spilled and 34 pints were sold. In the evening the rest was served in cups, at 2 cups to a pint. How many cups of chowder were served?
w10_T4_000547: In the morning the canteen prepares 222 pints of juice and adds 37 more, stirring it twice. In the afternoon the juice is served in cups, at 2 cups to a pint, and the canteen does exactly this every day for 7 days. In the evening of the last day 56 extra cups are poured. How many cups of juice were served in all?
w10_T4_000549: In the morning Ona's stall had 195 apples, and a dozen regulars watched her unload 34 more. In the afternoon she sold 124 apples. In the evening she cut every remaining apple into 8 wedges and sold each wedge for 4 cents, putting the money in her wedge tin. How many cents are in the wedge tin?
w10_T4_000554: Hugo had 25 kites and sold 21. He gave half of the rest to his sister and kept the other half in his kite chest. The wind was 20 kilometres an hour. He bought 49 kites for the chest and later sold 45 from it. Every kite in the chest has 7 tails. How many tails are on the kites in the chest?
w10_T4_000556: Captain Ada's fleet has 40 ships. Each ship has 4 holds, each hold carries 6 containers, and each container holds 9 pallets. Each pallet carries 3 crates, each crate holds 7 boxes, and each box holds 8 bottles. Captain Bo's fleet carries fewer bottles than Ada's. How many bottles does Ada's fleet carry?
w10_T4_000560: Ida had 104 coins and spent 102 on a game. She earned 29 coins washing cars and found 29 more in a coat. Every coin converts to 3 points in the club, and her brother Finn has fewer points than Ida. How many points does Ida have?
w10_T4_000563: In the morning 136 guests checked into the resort. In the afternoon 67 more arrived, and then 63 more. In the evening every guest was given 4 dinner tokens, and 11 extra tokens were issued to staff. How many dinner tokens were issued?
w10_T4_000566: In the morning Ade's farm had 102 crates of yams, and a matching delivery doubled the number; each crate holds 7 boxes. In the afternoon each box was split into 4 bags, and the bags were shared equally among 3 markets. In the evening every bag at the first market sold for 5 coins, and each coin is worth 6 loyalty points. Ade earned more loyalty points than Bola. How many loyalty points did Ade earn at the first market?
w10_T4_000567: The bakery had 15 boxes, each with 2 layers of 9 muffins, and stacked all the muffins on the counter. It sold 146 muffins and gave 25 away as samples. Then 73 fresh muffins were added to the counter. How many muffins are on the counter?
w10_T4_000570: In the morning the warehouse held 187 crates, shipped 184, and found 2 damaged, which were checked twice. In the afternoon 73 crates arrived and 55 were shipped. In the evening each remaining crate was opened, and each holds 6 jars. How many jars were unpacked?
w10_T4_000571: Bo had 14 stamps and received 55 more. He traded every stamp for 3 coins. He spent 116 coins on a game and earned 66 coins washing windows. Each coin is worth 8 points, and Cleo has fewer points than Bo. How many points does Bo have?
w10_T4_000574: The crew laid 168 fathoms of cable and recorded it in feet, since a fathom is 6 feet. They added 76 feet at the pier, 57 feet along the wall, and 56 feet to the hut. How many feet of cable did they record?
w10_T4_000575: The school has 151 pupils; 55 joined and 89 left. The food drive runs twice a year, and each pupil brought 9 cans. The cans were shared equally among 3 food banks. The first food bank added 69 cans of its own and handed out 342. How many cans does the first food bank have?
